mapper.select: SELECT order_id, order_no, order_type_code, status_code, payment_status_code, payment_method_name, total_price, created_at FROM vw_order_summary WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT menu_id AS menuId, menu_name AS menuName, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, option_items AS optionItems, excluded_ingredients AS excludedIngredients FROM vw_order_item_full WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

where.if: AND ( o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_item oi JOIN menu m ON m.id = oi.menu_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') ) )

mapper.select:
WITH paged_orders AS ( SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.created_at, o.total_price, ot.code AS order_type_code, st.code AS status_code, ps.code AS payment_status_code FROM orders o JOIN common_code ot ON ot.id = o.order_type_id JOIN common_code st ON st.id = o.status_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN common_code ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{filter.limit} OFFSET #{filter.offset} ), item_summary AS ( SELECT oi.order_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS item_count, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(m.name ORDER BY oi.id SEPARATOR '||'), '||', 1 ) AS first_menu_name FROM order_item oi JOIN menu m ON m.id = oi.menu_id JOIN paged_orders po ON po.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY oi.order_id ) SELECT po.order_id AS orderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, po.order_type_code AS orderType, po.status_code AS orderStatus, po.payment_status_code AS paymentStatus, po.total_price AS totalAmount, po.created_at AS createdAt, item_summary.item_count AS itemCount, CASE WHEN item_summary.line_count > 1 THEN CONCAT( item_summary.first_menu_name, ' 외 ', item_summary.line_count - 1 ) ELSE item_summary.first_menu_name END AS menuSummary FROM paged_orders po JOIN item_summary ON item_summary.order_id = po.order_id ORDER BY po.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN common_code ot ON ot.id = o.order_type_id JOIN common_code st ON st.id = o.status_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN common_code ps ON ps.id = p.status_id

SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, order_type_label AS orderTypeLabel, status_code AS orderStatus, total_price AS totalAmount, created_at AS createdAt, elapsed_sec AS elapsedSec, menus FROM vw_order_live ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, order_type_code AS orderType, status_code AS orderStatus, payment_status_code AS paymentStatus, total_price AS totalAmount, created_at AS createdAt, item_count AS itemCount, menu_summary AS menuSummary FROM vw_order_list_summary WHERE status_code IN ('RECEIVED', 'PREPARING') ORDER BY created_at
